Bấm để máy tự động đọc lần lượt từng từ và hiển thị theo dõi (phù hợp học trên điện thoại)
1. civilization (n)
/ˌsɪvəlaɪˈzeɪʃn/
nền văn minh (Ai Cập cổ đại, Hy Lạp, Lưỡng Hà...)
Collocation: ancient civilization, early human civilization
"The ancient Egyptian civilization built magnificent pyramids along the Nile River."
2. ancient (adj)
/ˈeɪnʃənt/
cổ đại, xưa cũ hàng nghìn năm
Collocation: ancient history, ancient manuscripts
"Archaeologists found ancient coins dating back over two thousand years."
3. excavate (v)
/ˈekskəveɪt/
khai quật (đào bới khảo cổ học)
Collocation: excavate a burial site, carefully excavated
"It took researchers five years to excavate the buried Roman villa."
4. artifact (n)
/ˈɑːtɪfækt/
cổ vật, hiện vật lịch sử do con người chế tác
Collocation: precious historical artifact, bronze artifact
"Over three hundred bronze artifacts are on display in the national museum."
5. monument (n)
/ˈmɒnjumənt/
đài tưởng niệm, công trình di tích lịch sử
Collocation: historic monument, stone monument
"Stonehenge is the most mysterious prehistoric stone monument in Britain."
6. empire (n)
/ˈempaɪə(r)/
đế chế, đế quốc
Collocation: the Roman Empire, vast empire
"At its height, the Roman Empire controlled lands across Europe and North Africa."
7. historian (n)
/hɪˈstɔːriən/
nhà sử học, học giả nghiên cứu lịch sử
Collocation: leading historian, modern historian
"Historians study royal letters and diaries to understand how kings ruled."
8. exhibition (n)
/ˌeksɪˈbɪʃn/
cuộc triển lãm, gian trưng bày tại bảo tàng
Collocation: permanent exhibition, special museum exhibition
"The British Museum is hosting a special exhibition on ancient silk trade."
9. chronicle (n/v)
/ˈkrɒnɪkl/
biên niên sử; ghi chép lại theo trình tự thời gian
Collocation: historical chronicle, chronicle the events
"Ancient stone carvings chronicle the victories of early emperors."
10. origin (n)
/ˈɒrɪdʒɪn/
nguồn gốc, cội nguồn xuất xứ
Collocation: trace the origin of, humble origin
"Linguists are trying to trace the exact origin of this ancient alphabet."
11. ruin (n)
/ˈruːɪn/
tàn tích, phế tích cổ (thường dùng số nhiều: ruins)
Collocation: ancient temple ruins, explore the ruins
"While workers were digging a subway tunnel, they uncovered the ruins of a palace."
12. dynasty (n)
/ˈdɪnəsti/
triều đại phong kiến
Collocation: ruling dynasty, royal dynasty
"Fine porcelain vases were produced during the Ming dynasty."
13. display (v/n)
/dɪˈspleɪ/
trưng bày, triển lãm cho công chúng xem (on display)
Collocation: display in a glass case, on public display
"Interactive screens allow museums to display 3D models of ancient cities."
14. ancestor (n)
/ˈænsestə(r)/
tổ tiên, ông cha đời trước
Collocation: early human ancestors, honour our ancestors
"Learning history helps young people appreciate the sacrifices of their ancestors."
15. discover (v)
/dɪˈskʌvə(r)/
khám phá, phát hiện ra điều chưa biết
Collocation: discover a hidden tomb, newly discovered
"In 1922, Howard Carter discovered the intact tomb of King Tutankhamun."

⚙️ 2. Bài Giảng Ngữ Pháp 2 Tầng (Grammar Masterclass)

🟢 Tầng 1: Căn Bản (Quá Khứ Tiếp Diễn vs. Quá Khứ Đơn Trong Tường Thuật Lịch Sử)

• Quá khứ tiếp diễn (Past Continuous): was / were + V-ing (Diễn tả hành động đang diễn ra tại một thời điểm trong quá khứ hoặc làm nền cho hành động khác cắt ngang).
  Công thức phối hợp kinh điển: While + S1 + was/were + V-ing, S2 + V2/ed (Quá khứ đơn)
  Ví dụ: While farmers were digging a well in 1974, they discovered the famous Terracotta Army.

• Quá khứ đơn (Past Simple): Dùng cho chuỗi sự kiện lịch sử đã hoàn tất (in the 15th century, 2,000 years ago, during the Ly dynasty).

🔵 Tầng 2: Nâng Cao (Cụm Giới Từ Chỉ Mốc Thời Gian Học Thuật Trong Reading & Writing)

• Hệ thống từ nối thời gian lịch sử (Historical Time Markers):
  - Prior to + Noun / V-ing (= Before: Trước khi...)
  - During the reign of... (Dưới triều đại / thời kỳ trị vì của...)
  - Subsequently, / Thereafter, (Sau đó, tiếp theo đó...)
  Ví dụ: Prior to the invention of paper, ancient historians carved chronicles onto stone or bamboo.

🎯 20 Câu Test Từ Vựng (Vocabulary Mastery Test)

1. The Indus Valley and Mesopotamia were two of the earliest human ________ in world history.
2. A team of archaeologists spent three summers working to ________ the buried city of Pompeii.
3. Gold jewellery and clay pots are precious ________ that show how people lived thousands of years ago.
4. The Imperial Citadel of Thang Long was built across several royal ________ in Vietnamese history.
5. Next month, the National Museum will open a special ________ of Egyptian mummies and statues.
6. Leading ________ have studied ancient tax records to understand how the Roman ________ was governed.
7. Thousands of tourists climb the mountain trail to photograph the stone ________ of Machu Picchu.
8. DNA testing helps scientists trace the ________ and migration routes of our early human ________.
9. The newly restored royal crown is now on public ________ in the central hall of the museum.
10. In 1799, soldiers in Egypt ________ the Rosetta Stone, which helped scholars read hieroglyphs.
11. The Lincoln Memorial is a famous marble ________ in Washington, D.C.
12. Medieval monks wrote detailed ________ that recorded every king, battle, and harvest.
13. ________ Greek philosophers such as Socrates and Plato still influence modern education today.
14. Virtual reality headsets allow museums to ________ fragile manuscripts without exposing them to light.
15. Studying how ancient ________ collapsed due to drought teaches us valuable lessons about climate change.
16. [Ôn tập Chặng 2 - Unit 9] Visitors must be ________ when entering ancient temples and heritage sites.
17. [Ôn tập Chặng 2 - Unit 8] A reliable underground metro ________ makes it easy to reach the city museum.
18. [Ôn tập Chặng 2 - Unit 7] Instead of being demolished, the old railway station was ________ into a history museum.
19. [Ôn tập Chặng 2 - Unit 6] Grandparents pass down stories about family ________ to the younger generation.
20. [Ôn tập Chặng 1 - Unit 3] National parks help ________ both natural biodiversity and ancient forest ruins.
Điểm: 0/20

⚙️ 10 Câu Test Ngữ Pháp Ứng Dụng (Grammar Mastery Test)

1. While engineers ________ a new metro tunnel in Rome, they discovered the ruins of an ancient bathhouse.
2. Archaeologists ________ over five hundred gold artifacts when they opened the royal tomb in 1922.
3. ________ the invention of modern radar, historians had to rely solely on written chronicles to locate lost cities.
4. What ________ the archaeologist looking for when she entered the underground cave?
5. Many magnificent stone temples were constructed ________ the reign of the Khmer Empire.
6. While one team was cleaning the ancient pottery, another team ________ the temple walls.
7. The palace was destroyed by an earthquake in 1690; ________, the royal dynasty moved the capital south.
8. Local fishermen were repairing their nets when they ________ a bronze statue on the seabed.
9. Three thousand years ago, early civilizations ________ along fertile river valleys.
10. Because the fragile scroll had been buried for centuries, experts ________ it very carefully.

💡 Bấm vào bất kỳ câu thoại nào để nghe riêng câu đó:
Museum Guide: Good morning, and welcome to the National Museum of Archaeology! How can I assist you today?
Visitor: Hello! I would like to buy a ticket for the new special exhibition on Ancient River Civilizations.
Museum Guide: Great choice! That exhibition is located on the Second Floor, in the Silk Road Gallery. 💡 Đáp án câu 1: Silk Road
Visitor: What is the most famous artifact on display in that gallery?
Museum Guide: It is a 3,000-year-old golden mask that archaeologists discovered while they were excavating a royal tomb. 💡 Đáp án câu 2: golden mask
Visitor: Incredible! Are there any guided tours with a historian this morning?
Museum Guide: The 10:00 AM tour is full, but you can join the next tour starting at 11:15 AM. 💡 Bẫy giờ đã kín chỗ vs giờ còn trống câu 3: 11:15
Visitor: 11:15 AM works perfectly for me. Who is leading the tour today?
Museum Guide: It is led by Professor Chambers. That is spelled C - H - A - M - B - E - R - S. 💡 Đáp án đánh vần câu 4: CHAMBERS
Visitor: Does the museum have an interactive section for students and families?
Museum Guide: Yes! In the Discovery Hall, visitors can use 3D glasses to explore the ruins of an ancient Roman monument. 💡 Đáp án câu 5: 3D glasses
Visitor: How much is the admission ticket for the special exhibition?
Museum Guide: General admission to the museum is free, and the special exhibition ticket is 12 pounds, or 8 pounds for students. 💡 Đáp án giá vé sinh viên câu 6: 8
Visitor: Here is my student ID card and 8 pounds.
Museum Guide: Thank you! Here is your ticket and audio guide. Enjoy your journey into the ancient world!

📰 IELTS Academic Reading: Passage & Questions

[Paragraph A - Accidental Discoveries and Excavations]
Throughout history, some of the greatest archaeological treasures were found by accident. For example, in 1974, while local farmers were digging a water well in China, they discovered an underground army of clay warriors built during the Qin dynasty. Subsequently, professional archaeologists arrived to excavate the site carefully. Every artifact—from bronze swords to royal chariots—helped historians understand how an ancient empire united the country.

[Paragraph B - Tracing Human Origins Through Science]
Today, studying early human civilizations no longer relies solely on shovels and written chronicles. Scientists now use satellite lasers to map stone ruins and monuments hidden beneath thick jungle canopies. In addition, chemical analysis of ancient bones allows researchers to trace the exact origin, diet, and migration routes of our distant ancestors.

[Paragraph C - Modern Museums in the Digital Age]
Once fragile objects are rescued from the ground, public museums play a vital role in preserving them. Rather than locking objects in dusty rooms, modern museums organize interactive exhibitions that display 3D holograms alongside real historical treasures. By making history vivid and accessible, museums inspire younger generations to value their cultural roots.
Điểm: 0/6
